{{Youmay|a fighting weapon|a [[Hachete (droid)|droid by the same name]]}}
A '''hachete''' was a double-edged blade used in fighting and dueling. Heavy like a hatchet but short and edged like a machete, the hachete was a double-edged fighting blade as long and as wide as a Human forearm, with razor-sharp edges.
